text:
alex: thinking about a tiny policy DSL to control sampling for quota rollouts. aim: expressive rules (tenant cohorts, route patterns), per-route caps, dry-run mode.
priya: yes — want "1% of tenants in beta OR routes /preview", plus per-route hard cap. makes console readable.
julius: must funnel samples through scrubber before storing. scrubber rules need audit trail.
sasha: add dry-run where we emit metrics but don't persist payloads to validate policy impact.
alex: DSL sketch: policy sampling_v1; rules: name=beta_preview rate=0.01 match=tenant.tier=="beta" or route.path starts_with("/preview") per_route_cap=500 dry_run=true
priya: default caps: hosted 1000/hr, dedicated/private lower and off by default.
julius: telemetry: emit sample.evaluated and sample.stored events. metrics carry only ids and counts, not payloads.
ops-bot: ops note: shard backpressure circuit if storage_write_latency>75ms for 30s -> disable storing, keep eval-only.
sasha: console UX: preview policy impact, estimated storage, toggle dry_run->store, CSV export for ops.
alex: API proposal: POST /internal/v1/samples batch with Idempotency-Key header; 202 accepted; response includes sample ids.
security: scrubber must be versioned, applied server-side, with a redact whitelist; retention defaults: canary TTL 6h, debug sink TTL 30d with approval.
priya: feature-flag: sampling_ballot.enabled { hosted:true, dedicated:false, private:false } to avoid surprise for enterprise customers.
ops-bot: runbook: auto-unpause after 10m if pressure clears; manual stop for SEV. add dashboard tile sample.write_latency + storage_pressure.
alex: rollout plan: UI -> staging policy -> dry-run 2h -> canary 1% tenants (store) -> monitor metrics; tagging @security and @ops for reviews.
deploy-bot: rollout queued by @alex staging->canary->prod window 02:00-05:00 UTC.
alex: i'll write RFC and PR with sample schema and scrubber rules. thanks everyone.
